CommunityApplications.Profile:
Discord Bot is a lightweight, self-hosted Discord.js bot designed for Docker and Unraid.
The container provides a simple starting point for hosting a Discord bot, with a built-in web interface for monitoring its status, uptime, and connected servers.
Features include Discord bot connectivity, environment-based token configuration, a web dashboard, and restart controls.
This repository is maintained by THALF. For support, bug reports, or feature requests, please visit the GitHub repository.
